name: Learn basic jump-rope tricks
blurb: Crossovers, side swings, high knees and the double under turn a workout into something worth watching, and each one has a specific drill that shortcuts the learning.
steps: Get the basic bounce genuinely automatic first — three unbroken minutes.
Learn the side swing: swing the rope beside your body without jumping, as the entry point to every cross.
Learn the criss-cross: cross your arms deep so the loop stays open, jump through, uncross.
Learn boxer skip and high knees for footwork variation.
Learn the double under: a slightly higher jump plus a much faster wrist turn. Practise as single-double-single before attempting consecutive ones.
String four tricks into a 30-second freestyle.
tips: Double unders fail on wrist speed, not jump height. Jumping higher makes it worse.
Crossing shallowly closes the loop. Cross past your elbows.
proof: Ten consecutive double unders and a 30-second sequence using three different tricks.
